decision_record: DR-PX-2026-11-11-021 (MWS-15; MWS-11 for the palette's way into split view; sections 5.11 and 9)
status: built and proven locally on macOS arm64; not sealed (graph.py was not run: sealing is not this task's)

audit.classification: IMPLEMENTED-PARTIAL: the palette over task titles and commands, the Core's conversation search (agent list, @ menu) and the folder listing and file read (Files pane) PRODUCTION-WORKING; the palette called neither, the Files pane could not be asked to show a file, and a palette item had one action
audit.first_missing_link: the palette's items were only what the window held (task titles, commands): nothing in it reached searchConversations or listWorkspaceDir, and FilesApp had no way to be told which file to show
audit.traced: CommandPalette -> usePaletteSearch -> window.modbit.searchConversations (main conversation:search -> Core SearchConversations) and window.modbit.listWorkspaceDir per folder (main files:list -> Core ListWorkspaceDir, path policy) -> rows; Enter -> openConversation(taskId, rowId) | setPanelState(openPane files) + FilesApp reveal -> readWorkspaceFile (files:read -> Core ReadWorkspaceFile) | shellRegistry.run | openConversation; Alt+Enter on a task -> openSplit (PX-204, requestSplit + splitRefusal)

decided_here.groups: Tasks, In conversations, Files, Commands, in that order; a group only when it has results
decided_here.conversation_rows: the Core's first snippet per hit, at most 8 hits, two characters or more, 150 ms after typing pauses; title-only hits are task rows
decided_here.file_walk: breadth first through listWorkspaceDir while the palette is open, at most 400 folders and 20000 names, protected folders, .git and node_modules not entered
decided_here.file_match: name prefix, then name, then path containing the text; no scattered letters
decided_here.split: Open in split view on the highlighted task row (Alt+Enter, Alt+click), PX-204's openSplit and its refusals unchanged; closes PX-204's left-out item

left_out: a file result when the Files pane is in its own window (the window comes forward; it is not told the file)
files under node_modules and .git and beyond the walk's bound
conversations of other sessions (the Core's search is per session)
the board's New task about … and Change run mode rows (not in the command registry)
proof: e2e/px-209-search.spec.ts 1 of 1 locally against the real app and a real Core (sha256 c5ec630a...), see TASK_CARD.md Verification
